### html2md

``` python
def html2md(
    s:str, # HTML to convert
    ignore_links:bool=True, # Drop links, keeping their text
    ignore_images:bool=True, # Drop images
    base_url:str='', # URL that relative link and image URLs resolve against
):
```

*Convert `s` from HTML to markdown, with code blocks fenced*

[`html2md`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/toolslm/download.html#html2md)
fences code blocks, and resolves relative link and image URLs against
`base_url` when it keeps them:

``` python
s = '<p>See <a href="b.html">this</a> <img alt="fig" src="f.png"></p><pre><code>  x = 1\n  y = 2</code></pre>'
md = html2md(s, ignore_links=False, ignore_images=False, base_url='https://ex.org/a/')
assert '[this](https://ex.org/a/b.html)' in md and '![fig](https://ex.org/a/f.png)' in md
assert '````\nx = 1\ny = 2\n````' in md
md
```

### read_html

``` python
def read_html(
    url, # URL to read
    sel:NoneType=None, # Read only outerHTML of CSS selector `sel`
    rm_comments:bool=True, # Removes HTML comments
    rm_details:bool=True, # Removes `<details>` tags
    multi:bool=False, # Get all matches to `sel` or first one
    wrap_tag:NoneType=None, # If multi, each selection wrapped with <wrap_tag>content</wrap_tag>
    ignore_links:bool=True
):
```

*Get `url`, optionally selecting CSS selector `sel`, and convert to
clean markdown*

``` python
# test single class selector
listings = read_html('https://www.answer.ai/', sel='.listing-description')
assert len(listings) < 500

# Test multi class selector
listings = read_html('https://www.answer.ai/', sel='.listing-description', multi=True)
assert len(listings) > 1000 # returns more than single so selecting multi

# Test multi_wrap_tag
listings = read_html('https://www.answer.ai/', sel='.listing-description', multi=True, wrap_tag='document')
assert '<document>' in listings and '</document>' in listings
```

``` python
read_html('https://www.answer.ai/', sel='.listing-description', ignore_links=False)
```

    '[ How data quality, proxy measures, and missing domain expertise can undermine AI science results ](./posts/2026-03-17-risks-life-sciences/index.html)\n\n'

``` python
# test tag css selectors
assert len(read_html('https://www.answer.ai/', sel='div.listing-description', multi=True)) > 1000
assert len(read_html('https://www.answer.ai/', sel='div', multi=True)) > 1000
```

``` python
htmlurl = 'https://hypermedia.systems/hypermedia-a-reintroduction/'
hmd = read_html(htmlurl)
assert len(hmd) > 100
# Markdown(hmd)
```

[`read_url`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/toolslm/download.html#read_url)
reads a page the way a browser would, through
[`scrape_url`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/toolslm/download.html#scrape_url),
which gets past Cloudflare’s bot checks. It converts HTML to markdown
with
[`html2md`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/toolslm/download.html#html2md),
keeping links and images with absolute URLs. A URL fragment, such as
`#unit-files`, selects just that section, and `selector` selects
elements by CSS selector instead. Content that isn’t HTML, such as an
`llms.txt` file, comes back unchanged.

### scrape_url

``` python
def scrape_url(
    url
):
```

*Get `url` with a Cloudflare-aware scraper, decoding text without a
declared encoding as UTF-8*

html2text escapes every backslash that precedes punctuation. In TeX,
that turns `\{` into `\\{`. To keep each formula intact,
[`_tex_math`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/toolslm/download.html#_tex_math)
replaces it with a placeholder before conversion.
[`read_url`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/toolslm/download.html#read_url)
puts the TeX back afterwards.

### read_url

``` python
def read_url(
    url:str, # URL to read
    as_md:bool=True, # Convert HTML to markdown
    extract_section:bool=True, # Extract section matching URL fragment or selector
    selector:str=None, # CSS selector to extract specific content
):
```

*Read `url`, converting HTML to markdown with absolute link and image
URLs*

``` python
read_url('https://www.example.org')
```

A fragment selects the section that starts at that id, up to the next
element of the same kind:

``` python
sec = read_url('https://caddyserver.com/docs/running#unit-files')
assert sec.startswith('### Unit Files')
sec[:300]
```

Formulas in MathML that carry their TeX source, as in arXiv’s HTML
papers, come back as TeX, written `\(...\)` inline and `$$...$$` for
display math:

``` python
att = read_url('https://arxiv.org/html/1706.03762v7#S3.SS2.SSS1')
assert r'$$\mathrm{Attention}(Q,K,V)' in att and r'\(d_{k}\)' in att
Markdown(att)
```

Plain text, such as an `llms.txt` file, keeps its own line breaks:

``` python
read_url('https://fastht.ml/docs/llms.txt').splitlines()[:3]
```
